dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Adds concrete, senior‑engineer‑level thresholds (e.g., password length ≥ 12, token validity 5 min‑1 h, service limits) and a prioritized pre‑check list that is not commonly memorised. Most of the content restates official AWS documentation, so the delta is useful but not maximal.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Encodes AWS‑specific workflow: pre‑flight checks, CONFIRM gate, snapshot before update, exact CLI sequence, and post‑verification steps. Some steps remain generic (e.g., “run CLI”) and pagination handling for list‑user‑pools is only hinted, preventing a perfect score.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Provides a solid NEVER list with concrete reasons (implicit flow, ALLOW_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH, missing DeletionProtection, SMS MFA role, undeclared custom attributes). Lacks a few common pitfalls (e.g., forgetting to enable token revocation, DNS propagation delays for custom domains) so two points are deducted.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Front‑matter is complete, description clearly states WHAT the skill does, WHEN to invoke, and includes a rich keyword set and activation triggers. Minor vagueness exists in overlapping trigger phrases, but overall the spec would reliably activate the skill.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Information is layered: quick reference first, then mindset, pre‑flight, process, patterns, output contract, NEVER list, heuristic, recent features. The sheer volume may cause cognitive overload, and some deep details (e.g., pagination token handling) are buried, costing two points.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions are tightly constrained with CONFIRM gate and exhaustive pre‑checks; creative tasks (e.g., custom branding) are left flexible. However, the example output uses placeholder <returned-id>, violating the rule that no placeholders appear in a READY_TO_DEPLOY plan, losing one point.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable structure (What it does → Quick navigation → Mindset → Pre‑flight → Process → Common patterns → Output contract → NEVER → Heuristic). The pattern is coherent and aids comprehension.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides exact CLI commands, pre‑check list, and post‑verify steps, enabling an agent to execute the plan. Deductions: examples contain placeholders (<returned-id>), pagination handling is only hinted, and no explicit error‑handling strategy for failed AWS CLI calls, reducing usability.
